newsitem.title: USA: Aasche names chief operating officer.
newsitem.headline: Aasche names chief operating officer.

text.p: Aasche Transportation Services Inc said Friday Daniel Wright was named chief operating officer, taking over some of the duties of Larry Ashe, who remains chairman.
Wright had been executive vice president for the Polar Express subsidiary since February 1996.
Aasche also named Jack Todd as general manager of Polar Express, taking over Wright's duties in that unit.
Earlier, Aasche reported third quarter earnings of $0.03 a share, down from $0.13 a year ago. Revenues for the quarter were $18.6 million, down from $19.9 million.
"Third quarter revenues were negatively impacted by an unusual and unanticipated lack of demand for freight services out of the Florida marketplace" Ashe said.

Leon Monachos, chief financial officer, added that diesel fuel prices increased significantly throughout 1996. The company recovered a portion of the additional fuel costs through surcharges to customers, he said.
However, the increased fuel expenses that were absorbed by the company, coupled with incremental costs associated with the stagnant Florida market, were a drag on third quarter earnings, he added.
